messages:
nora (billing): Clemens Labs (acct_5599) - INV-2026-1013 had 5 card declines during scheduled charge. They asked to do a wire instead of retrying the card. Can we send wire instructions and confirm if we can waive the late fee if they wire today? @fiona?

payments-bot: payment_attempt_failed: 5 attempts (2026-12-03T15:02:11Z, 15:08:20Z, 15:14:39Z, 15:29:02Z, 16:01:07Z) -> decline_code: issuer_declined; processor_msg: processing_error

asha (acct-mgr): Invoice INV-2026-1013 amount $7,950 due 2026-12-04. Their AP said the issuing bank blocked the transaction for fraud reasons and they'd rather wire. They asked whether Redwood covers any intermediary routing fees and what proof we need.

fiona (finance): Finance position: we can waive the one-time late fee ($45) if (1) proof of wire initiation (screenshot or MT103) is received within 48 hours, and (2) treasury posts funds within 5 business days. Need treasury + compliance to confirm origin bank match to KYC.

mike (treasury): Treasury checklist: require MT103 or confirmation email from originating bank. We don't automatically absorb intermediary fees. We can credit up to $75 for intermediary charges on a per-wire basis for first-time emergency wires for mid-market customers if MT103 shows the charge. If originator bank doesn't match KYC, require AP contact verification.

compliance-bot: compliance_rule: if originator country != customer country OR originator bank not on KYC -> require AP email + bank statement (last 3 months) OR live verification call. MT103 containing originator info can fast-track approval.

nora (billing): Bank block for customer email (paste into reply):
"""
Bank: Northbridge Commercial Bank
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account: 3344556677
Routing (ABA/ACH): 061000104
SWIFT: NBCBUS44
Reference: INV-2026-1013 / Clemens Labs (acct_5599)
"""
Please ask payer to include invoice reference exactly and reply with MT103 or screenshot of the transfer confirmation to billing@redwood.ai.

asha (acct-mgr): I'll send that now. I'll include this sentence: "We will hold suspension for 72 hours pending receipt of payment confirmation; once treasury confirms funds we will mark INV-2026-1013 as paid and apply any agreed waivers."

fiona (finance): After treasury confirms, billing should set payment method to 'wire', run usage reconciliation for the billing period, and create an AR reconciliation ticket if net posted amount differs from invoice by >$25 due to fees/FX.

mike (treasury): Operational note: if the wire arrives net of intermediary fees, treasury will post the net amount. If the customer requests Redwood to reimburse intermediary fees, they must include MT103 showing the fees and we will issue a credit up to the approved cap. Also: ask AP to initiate the wire early in the business day to speed posting.

nora (billing): Moving INV-2026-1013 to "awaiting wire". Will apply waiver after treasury posts funds and compliance confirms origin bank or we receive supporting docs. Tagging treasury & compliance for monitoring. :white_check_mark:
